statements.text: A prehension is the most concrete element into which an actual entity can be analyzed. It refers to an external world, so it has vector character, and it involves emotion, purpose, valuation and causation. Every prehension has three factors: the subject that prehends, the datum prehended, and the subjective form, which is how the subject prehends the datum. Prehensions of actual entities are physical, prehensions of eternal objects conceptual.
